settings.heading: Makeup and Tan Services
settings.intro: Special occasion studio makeup or spray tan.
settings.body: Book and pay online to secure your date.

settings.cta_note: Opens the calendar to select a date and confirm. Bookings open up to 4 months in advance.

settings.title: Spray Tan
settings.description: Achieve a flawless, natural-looking glow every time. Choose from subtle sun-kissed tones to a deep, bronzed radiance — custom colour selection and professional application for even, streak-free results.

settings.title: Special Occasion Makeup
settings.description: Perfect for formals, engagements, birthdays, or a night out. Receive a polished, camera-ready look tailored to your features and outfit, including skin prep and false lashes for a long-lasting finish.

settings.heading: Deposits & Payments
settings.items:
- Spray tan: full payment of $50 is required to book.
- Special occasion makeup: $100 deposit is required at booking; remaining balance of $100 payable in studio on the day.

settings.heading: Cancellations & Credits
settings.items:
- Standard bookings (spray tan & special occasion makeup): cancel at least 72 hours before your appointment to receive your payment/deposit as a credit toward a future booking (valid for 12 months). Cancellations within 72 hours forfeit the payment/deposit.
- Bridal bookings: cancel at least 7 days before the appointment to receive the deposit as a credit (valid for 12 months). Cancellations within 7 days forfeit the deposit.

settings.heading: Exceptions
settings.items: Exceptions for documented emergencies can be considered at our discretion.

settings.heading: Make an Enquiry
settings.subheading: Tell us which service you're after and your preferred date, and we'll come back to you.
settings.note: We'll only use your details to reply to your enquiry.
settings.success: Thank you — your enquiry is on its way. We'll be in touch shortly.
